data.description: Discover a fantastic opportunity in the heart of Douglasville with this solid 1973 ranch-style home, offering both reliability and immense potential. This residence has been meticulously maintained, boasting significant mechanical upgrades that provide peace of mind for any buyer. The interior currently offers three comfortable bedrooms and two bathrooms, but the true value lies in the expansive full basement. This lower level currently serves as a functional living space and offers the perfect footprint for expansion. With its existing layout, there is clear potential to easily add a fourth bedroom, making it an ideal candidate for growing families or those looking to add instant equity through finished square footage. The exterior is complemented by a generous 0.34-acre lot, providing plenty of outdoor space for gardening or entertaining. Situated in a quiet, established neighborhood, this home is perfect for a buyer looking to bring their modern cosmetic vision to a structurally sound foundation. Whether you are an investor looking for a high-yield rental or a homeowner ready to customize your forever home, the combination of recent mechanical updates and the versatile basement space makes this property a standout choice.
